! Network rules that should be rejected by the DNR validator.
! Each non-comment, non-empty line is a rule that either cannot be parsed
! or is unsupported for DNR conversion.

! === $replace — not expressible in DNR ===
||example.com^$replace=/ad/blocked/

! === $jsonprune — not supported ===
||example.com^$jsonprune=\$.ads

! === $hls — not supported ===
||example.com^$hls=/#EXTINF.+?broll/

! === $stealth — not supported ===
||example.com^$stealth

! === $genericblock — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$genericblock

! === DNS modifiers — not supported ===
||example.com^$client=192.168.1.1
||example.com^$dnsrewrite=NOERROR;A;127.0.0.1
||example.com^$dnstype=AAAA
||example.com^$ctag=device_phone

! === $network — desktop only, not supported ===
||example.com^$network

! === $redirect-rule — not supported ===
||example.com^$redirect-rule=noopjs

! === Allowlist with $csp — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$csp

! === Allowlist with $removeparam — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$removeparam

! === Allowlist with $removeheader — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$removeheader=refresh

! === Allowlist with $redirect — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$redirect=noopjs

! === Allowlist with $cookie — not supported ===
@@||example.com^$cookie

! === $removeparam with negation — not supported ===
||example.com^$removeparam=~utm_source

! === $removeparam with regex — not supported ===
||example.com^$removeparam=/^utm_/

! === $cookie with parameters — not supported ===
||example.com^$cookie=test;maxAge=3600

! === $header with regex value — not supported in DNR ===
||example.com^$header=set-cookie:/test/

! === $method with trace — not supported ===
||example.com^$method=trace

! === $removeparam with incompatible modifier $redirect ===
||example.com^$removeparam=utm,redirect=noopjs

! === $permissions with incompatible modifier $third-party ===
||example.com^$permissions=camera=(),third-party

! === $header combined with request-side $removeheader ===
||example.com^$header=set-cookie,removeheader=request:set-cookie
